title: BPW-2026-0583
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0583
BOE + BCA
CD ALL
SELECTION OF FIVE QUALIFIED CONTRACTORS – RAPID PEDESTRIAN FACILITY REPAIR PROGRAM CONTRACT SERIAL NO. 1 (RPFRP1)
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE Access Pacific, Inc., Alameda Construction Services, Inc., Axiom Group, Geronimo Concrete, Inc., and Palp, Inc. DBA Excel Paving Company, as the respective qualified, lowest bid price contractors to provide pedestrian facility repairs of urgent necessity under the RPFRP1 contract for a total on-call contract cost ceiling of $30,000,000 with a duration of three years;
AUTHORIZE the President or two members of the Board to execute signed contracts received from the five approved contractors and forward the five contracts to the City Clerk for attestation; and
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to administer the contracts to assign construction orders with a not-to-exceed amount of $300,000 to provide pedestrian facility repairs of urgent necessity and assign construction orders to the RPFRP1 contractors.
(W.O.: E1909521)
summary: The Board of Public Works is selecting five contractors for urgent pedestrian facility repairs citywide under a three-year on-call contract with a $30 million ceiling. The City Engineer could assign individual repair orders of up to $300,000.

flag.reason: A $30 million citywide on-call contract for urgent sidewalk and pedestrian repairs, which touches public streets.
